name: com.trystarrynightops/sanctions-tariff-lookup
title: Sanctions & Tariff Lookup
description: Screen names on US, UN, UK and EU sanctions lists; US HTS codes and total duty by origin.

tools.name: screen_party
tools.description: Screens one person, company, vessel or aircraft name against a mirrored copy of the U.S. Consolidated Screening List (trade.gov), which combines the export screening lists of the Departments of Commerce, State and the Treasury, including OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list and the BIS Entity List, and against mirrored copies of the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the UK Sanctions List (FCDO) and, when loaded, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list. Matches primary names and aliases while tolerating differences in case, accents, punctuation, word order, company suffixes (LLC, Ltd, GmbH, OOO), small typos, common transliterations and added place or office words (a city, a country, "head office", "branch"). Returns ranked possible matches with score, matched alias, list, programs, entity type, addresses, countries, IDs, a link to the official entry or list and the list's as-of date, or a no-match result at the chosen threshold.

name.description: Name to screen, as written on the document; any word order, with or without accents or a company suffix. Example: "Rosneft Oil Company".

country.description: Optional country filter: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "IR") or English name (e.g. "Iran"). Entries whose list record names only other countries are left out and counted; entries with no country on the list are kept.

type.description: Optional entity type filter. Entries from lists that do not state a type are kept.

min_score.description: Similarity threshold from 0.5 to 1.0 (default 0.85). 1.0 = identical after normalization; lower values return more and weaker possible matches.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return, 1 to 25 (default 5).

detail.description: "summary" (default) returns the key fields; "full" adds every alias, address, ID, date of birth and remark on the list entry.

lists.description: Optional: which lists to search. "us" = U.S. Consolidated Screening List (OFAC, BIS, State Department lists), "un" = UN Security Council Consolidated List, "uk" = UK Sanctions List (FCDO), "eu" = EU consolidated financial sanctions list. Default: every list loaded in the mirror (list_status shows which are loaded). A party on several lists appears once per list.

tools.name: screen_parties
tools.description: Screens up to 25 names in one call against the same list mirrors as screen_party (U.S. Consolidated Screening List, UN, UK and, when loaded, EU lists) and returns only the best possible match per name (or no match at the threshold) in compact form, with a summary count.

names.description: Names to screen (1 to 25), e.g. ["Acme Trading LLC", "Mar Azul"].

country.description: Optional country filter: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "IR") or English name (e.g. "Iran"). Entries whose list record names only other countries are left out and counted; entries with no country on the list are kept.

type.description: Optional entity type filter. Entries from lists that do not state a type are kept.

min_score.description: Similarity threshold from 0.5 to 1.0 (default 0.85). 1.0 = identical after normalization; lower values return more and weaker possible matches.

lists.description: Optional: which lists to search. "us" = U.S. Consolidated Screening List (OFAC, BIS, State Department lists), "un" = UN Security Council Consolidated List, "uk" = UK Sanctions List (FCDO), "eu" = EU consolidated financial sanctions list. Default: every list loaded in the mirror (list_status shows which are loaded). A party on several lists appears once per list.

tools.name: list_status
tools.description: Returns the versions of the mirrored data: each screening dataset (U.S. CSL, UN, UK, EU) with its as-of date, file timestamp, entry count and last update check, each list's name, agency, entry count and as-of date, the current HTS revision, and when the mirror was last built and last checked for updates.

tools.name: hts_search
tools.description: Searches the descriptions in the current Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (USITC) for product words and returns matching 8- and 10-digit HTS lines with code, description, parent headings, general (column 1) duty rate and unit of quantity. Some everyday terms (for example laptop, drone, e-bike) are mapped to HTS wording, and the mapping is shown in the result.

keyword.description: Product words, e.g. "copper wire", "lithium-ion batteries", "cotton t-shirts".

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return, 1 to 25 (default 10).

include_chapter_99.description: Also return Chapter 99 lines (additional duties and temporary provisions). Default false.

tools.name: hts_rate
tools.description: Looks up one HTS code (4, 6, 8 or 10 digits, with or without dots) in the current Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States and returns its description, parent hierarchy, general, special (trade program) and column 2 duty rates, units, footnotes, Chapter 99 cross-references and the lines below it.

hts_code.description: HTS number with 4, 6, 8 or 10 digits, dotted or not, e.g. "8471.30.01", "847130", "6109.10.00.12".

detail.description: "summary" (default) shortens long texts and lists up to 25 lines below; "full" returns complete texts and up to 150 lines.

tools.name: duty_stack
tools.description: Adds up the U.S. import duty on one 8- or 10-digit HTS line for goods of one country of origin under the current HTS revision: the column 1 (or column 2) rate plus the Chapter 99 additional duties in force that this tool models (Section 232 actions on metals, vehicles and other products, the Section 301 actions on China, Brazil and the 60 economies of the forced-labor action, and the Section 338 duties on Canada). Returns each layer with its Chapter 99 heading, rate and U.S. note, the exemptions it found, the total, the assumptions it made with what changes if an assumption is wrong, measures that are printed in the schedule but not in force, and what is not covered (for example antidumping and countervailing duties). When a question cannot be settled from the code and origin, the result says so and gives a range.

hts_code.description: HTS number with 8 or 10 digits, dotted or not, e.g. "6109.10.00" or "8471.30.01.00". Use hts_search to find a code from product words.

origin.description: Country of origin of the goods: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "CN") or English name (e.g. "Vietnam"). For the European Union name the member state.

customs_value_usd.description: Optional customs value in U.S. dollars; when given and the total is a percentage, an estimated duty amount is returned.

answers.description: Optional answers to the questions a previous result listed under "assumptions", by id, e.g. {"preference": true}.

ad_valorem_equivalent_pct.description: Optional: for a line with a specific or compound column 1 rate, the duty payable divided by the customs value, in percent. Needed only when the result asks for it.

detail.description: "full" adds the complete text of each Chapter 99 heading.

tools.name: compare_origins
tools.description: Computes the same duty total as duty_stack for one 8- or 10-digit HTS line across up to 30 countries of origin and returns them sorted from the lowest total, each with its base rate, the Chapter 99 headings applied and the number of open questions. Without "origins" it compares 20 large sources of U.S. imports. Each row uses default assumptions (no trade-agreement preference claimed, no special use).

hts_code.description: HTS number with 8 or 10 digits, dotted or not, e.g. "9403.60.80".

origins.description: Countries of origin to compare: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes or English names, e.g. ["CN", "VN", "MX"].

answers.description: Optional answers applied to every origin, by question id, e.g. {"preference": true}.

ad_valorem_equivalent_pct.description: Optional ad valorem equivalent, in percent, of a specific or compound column 1 rate.
